name: Jehoahaz
bio:
Jehoahaz succeeded his father Jehu as king of Israel after Jehu's twenty-eight-year reign ended and he was buried in Samaria (2 Kings 10:35).

## 📖 Core Story: Oppression and a Deliverer

Jehoahaz did evil in the LORD's eyes, following Jeroboam's sins, and the LORD gave Israel over to Hazael king of Syria and his son Ben-Hadad throughout his reign. Jehoahaz pleaded with the LORD, who heard him and saw Israel's oppression, and sent a deliverer so Israel escaped Syrian control, though the people never abandoned Jeroboam's sins and the Asherah pole remained standing in Samaria. By the time of his death, Syria had left Jehoahaz only fifty horsemen, ten chariots, and ten thousand foot soldiers, having crushed the rest like dust. He was buried in Samaria, and his son Joash (Jehoash) succeeded him (2 Kings 13:1-9).
